items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Joe Robeshow that played piano with us, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, we'd done that for quite a long time. And I guess you came back then, you made the English trip, did you? Yeah, it was, yeah, we went, it was from there. And we was working at the Sinton Hotel. Mm-hmm. When we got news that we was going overseas. Mm-hmm. So, we came on back home after we finished the engagement with Andrew Sinton. We came back home, that's the time I was trying to find Russell. Yeah. To see if I get our passport. Passport. Because George had his, you see. Yeah. Whether it was Jack, Howard,…
That was the band that made those records on Cavalier, remember? Yeah, Cavalier.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: So you got Nelson, George, Papa John Joseph, Robichaud piano, I was on drums, and Punch. And we all agreed to go.

ctx.x: That was 1963, up in office, I believe. I told him, yeah. I said, who with? He said, well, Joe Band, George. I said, well, all right. Well, Jim didn't want to go. So you got Nelson, George, Papa John Joseph, Robichaud piano, I was on drums, and Punch. And we all agreed to go. He said, there was a three-month tour. I said, yeah, I don't mind it. Well, we went over there, and we really made a smashing hit with the people. They really went for jazz, like hook, line, and sinker. They loved it. And we stayed over…
That was the last tour you went on?

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Yeah, none of them, the only man that got around was Joe Robichaud.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you enjoy that trip last year?

Oh, I had a wonderful, most enjoyable time I ever had in my life. I was kind of leery, you know, because you sit down and look at television and see different things about what's going to happen over there. And you hear the news about different things that's going on. Well, I stuck close with the band. Sure. Yeah, none of them, the only man that got around was Joe Robichaud. He about the only man that, you know, revealed away from the band going around the city and all that. He tried several times to get me to go…
Yeah. You had a lot of cold weather there too, I guess. Oh, plenty of cold weather.
